name: codebase
description: Codebase intelligence — Full TypeScript port of automatised-pipeline 0.0.9. Indexes Rust/Python/TypeScript/JavaScript into a PostgreSQL code-intelligence graph (shared cortex_agentic DB). Resolves imports + call chains, detects communities via Louvain+C2, traces execution flows via BFS. Hybrid PG-FTS+TF-IDF+RRF search. 23 MCP tools. No Rust binary required.
